gaps.sentence: The museum's ___ (EXHIBIT) of Egyptian art opens on Friday.
gaps.explanation: 'An exhibition' = a public display of art; 'an exhibit' is a single item.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: Much to everyone’s ___ (APPOINT), the open-air concert was cancelled.
gaps.explanation: 'To somebody’s disappointment' — the feeling noun follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
He was praised for his ___ (BRAVE) during the fire.
gaps.explanation: 'His bravery' — quality noun; 'braveness' exists but is rare; 'bravery' is standard.

gaps.sentence: The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.
